Enjoy the fun and energetic song “Kagaz Kalam Davaat La” from the blockbuster movie Hum (1991). Featuring Govinda and Shilpa Shirodkar, this lively track is sung by Mohammed Aziz and Shobha Joshi.
Kagaz Kalam Davaat La - Hum Movie Song | Govinda, Shilpa Shirodkar | Mohd Aziz | 90s Ke Hit Gaane
Song : Kagaz Kalam Davaat La
Movie : Hum (1991)
Star Cast: Govinda, Shilpa Shirodkar, Kader Khan
Singers: Mohammad Aziz & Shobha Joshi
Music Director: Laxmikant Pyarelal
Lyricist: Anand Bakshi
